svg.text: Steps · Hatua
B
L
S
parts of one inner box
KKP angles outside
five boxes in a row
vipande vya sanduku moja
pembe za KKP kwa nje
masanduku matano kwa mstari
Cut all parts from the list. In every wall the flutes run up and down: from above you look into
the open flutes. In the bottoms the flutes run along the long side. Cut with several light strokes
along the steel ruler, keep the corners square.
Kata vipande vyote vya orodha. Katika kila ukuta mawimbi yanaenda juu na chini: ukitazama kutoka
juu unaona matundu ya mawimbi. Katika vitako mawimbi yanafuata upande mrefu. Kata kwa mipigo
kadhaa myepesi kando ya rula ya chuma, pembe ziwe za mraba.
Cut KKP strips 30 mm wide and fold each one lengthwise in the middle, so that it forms an angle
with two legs of 15 mm. Cut them to the lengths in the list.
Kata vipande vya KKP vyenye upana wa mm 30 na kunja kila kimoja katikati kwa urefu wake, kiwe
pembe yenye pande mbili za mm 15. Vikate kwa urefu wa orodha.
Build one inner box: put the two long walls L on the bottom B, the two end walls S stand between
them. Glue the KKP angles on the outside: first the 4 bottom edges, then the 4 upright corners.
Spray the angle, wait a moment, press it on firmly.
Jenga sanduku moja la ndani: weka kuta mbili ndefu L juu ya kitako B, kuta mbili za mwisho S
zinasimama katikati yake. Gundisha pembe za KKP kwa nje: kwanza kingo 4 za chini, kisha pembe 4
zilizosimama. Nyunyiza gundi kwenye pembe, subiri kidogo, kisha ibonyeze kwa nguvu.
Make all five inner boxes 1 to 5 this way. Each box must be square and a card must fit in easily.
The number of the box is the number on L and B.
Tengeneza masanduku yote matano ya ndani 1 hadi 5 kwa njia hii. Kila sanduku liwe la mraba na kadi
iingie kwa urahisi. Namba ya sanduku ni namba iliyo kwenye L na B.
Glue the inner boxes together in a row, 1 to 5. Spray the end walls that touch, align bottoms and
top edges and press.
Gundisha masanduku ya ndani pamoja kwa mstari, 1 hadi 5. Nyunyiza gundi kwenye kuta za mwisho
zinazogusana, linganisha vitako na kingo za juu, kisha bonyeza.
